scope: Current frozen synthetic cohort as justification for adding THRML complexity to Hermes
surviving_quality_result: Host projected THRML, prototype and random controls each attain 96/96 exact verified feasible outputs through N32; no incremental THRML advantage is demonstrated.
deterministic_frontier: Component enumeration plus token knapsack reaches the same frozen optimum for all 48 tasks at lower measured CPU experiment overhead. Large connected real-evidence applicability is unproven.
slack_disposition: Small-N gate failed; all288 selected packs match initialization-only controls, despite sparse degree and correct ground-state encoding.
future_research: A different real-evidence problem requires a new frozen cohort and independent economic/quality justification. These negative results do not reject thermodynamic computation generally.
shared_goal_next_step: Complete the separately frozen real Hermes task and causal-evidence pair when provider capacity permits; retain deterministic context and protected checker. Do not expand the THRML integration from these results.
